test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which is the fifth state of India to withdraw general consent for CBI operations within its territory on 21 October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra **is the fifth state of India to withdraw general consent for CBI operations within its territory on 21 October 2020.
 
• **Nine states **have withdrawn general consent to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) to investigate cases.
 
• These include **Mizoram, West Bengal, Chhattisgarh, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Kerala, Jharkhand, Punjab and Meghalaya.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) was established in 1963__ by a resolution of the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption (1962-1964) recommended the establishment of the CBI.
 
• CBI Director: Rishi Kumar Shukla (From February 02, 2019)
 
• CBI attributes its powers to the Delhi Special Police Establishment Act of 1946.
 
• CBI is the major investigating agency of the Central Government and it performs an integral role in the prevention of corruption.
 
• It is neither a constitutional body nor a statutory body.
